const packagePath = "github.com/viant/datly/testfixture/withurireload/records"

type withURIFixture struct {
	db    *sqlite.Harness
	stage string
}

// Link the actual emitted Go contracts once. Each stage rediscovers persisted
// holders and resources; no runtime Go compilation or interpretation is used.
func (f *withURIFixture) compile(ctx context.Context, types *typecatalog.Catalog) (*application.Build, error) {
	workspace, err := (xmodule.LocalWorkspace{BaseDir: f.stage}).Resolve(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	routes, err := (bootstrap.PackageDiscovery{Workspace: workspace, Include: []string{packagePath}}).Discover(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(routes) != 2 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generated holder routes=%d, want 2", len(routes))
	}
	for i, route := range routes {
		if err = route.ValidateContractTypes(reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{})); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		want := []string{"/records", "/records/{id}"}[i]
		if route.Tag.Path != want || route.Tag.Method != "GET" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("holder %d route=%s %s, want GET %s", i, route.Tag.Method, route.Tag.Path, want)
		}
	}
	resolver, err := typecatalog.NewResolver(types, typecatalog.PackageAuthority, &typecatalog.ResolutionContext{PackagePath: packagePath})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	groups, err := bootstrap.GroupPackageComponentSources(routes, resolver)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(groups) != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("holder components=%d, want 1", len(groups))
	}
	component, err := groups[0].ResolveDescriptors(resolver)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(component.Routes) != 2 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reloaded component routes=%d, want 2 (no duplicate WithURI expansion)", len(component.Routes))
	}
	assets, err := (packageresources.Loader{Workspace: workspace, Packages: []string{packagePath}}).Load(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	artifact, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{Component: component, Types: types, Resources: assets.Store, InputType: reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), OutputType: reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{})})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(artifact.Component.Routes) != 2 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bootstrapped routes=%d, want 2", len(artifact.Component.Routes))
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		path   string
		fields int
	}{{"/records", 0}, {"/records/{id}", 1}} {
		plan, ok := artifact.Input.ForRoute(spec.RouteRef{Method: "GET", Path: tc.path})
		if !ok || len(plan.Fields()) != tc.fields {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("route %s input plan=%+v, want %d fields", tc.path, plan, tc.fields)
		}
	}
	execution, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: f.db.DB}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &application.Build{Types: types, Resources: assets.Store, Components: []*registry.RegisteredComponent{{Component: artifact.Component, Input: artifact.Input, Output: artifact.Output, OutputType: reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{}), Reader: execution}}}, nil
}

type withURIAcceptance struct {
	manager    *application.Manager
	native     *client.Client
	ctx        context.Context
	visibility string
}

func (c withURIAcceptance) check(t *testing.T, maximum int) {
	t.Helper()
	if c.native != nil {
		c.schemas(t)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		path, tool string
		args       map[string]any
		want       []int
	}{
		{"/records", "Records", map[string]any{}, []int{1, 2, 3}},
		{"/records/2", "RecordsById", map[string]any{"id": 2}, []int{2}},
		{"/records/4", "RecordsById", map[string]any{"id": 4}, []int{}},
		{"/records/0", "RecordsById", map[string]any{"id": 0}, []int{}},
		{"/records/99", "RecordsById", map[string]any{"id": 99}, []int{}},
	} {
		if maximum == 4 {
			if tc.path == "/records" {
				tc.want = []int{1, 2, 3, 4}
			}
			if tc.path == "/records/4" {
				tc.want = []int{4}
			}
		}
		var body []byte
		if c.native == nil {
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			c.manager.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", tc.path, nil).WithContext(c.ctx))
			if response.Code != 200 {
				t.Fatalf("HTTP %s: %d %s", tc.path, response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
			body = response.Body.Bytes()
		} else {
			result, err := c.native.CallTool(c.ctx, &schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: tc.tool, Arguments: tc.args})
			hidden := tc.tool == "Records" && c.visibility == "hidden-base" || tc.tool == "RecordsById" && c.visibility == "private-alternative"
			if hidden {
				var rpcErr *jsonrpc.Error
				if !errors.As(err, &rpcErr) || rpcErr.Code != jsonrpc.MethodNotFound || rpcErr.Message != fmt.Sprintf("tool %s not found", tc.tool) || result != nil {
					t.Fatalf("hidden tool %s: result=%+v error=%v", tc.tool, result, err)
				}
				continue
			}
			if err != nil || result == nil || result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError {
				t.Fatalf("MCP %s: %+v %v", tc.tool, result, err)
			}
			body, err = json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		var actual struct {
			Data []struct {
				ID int `json:"id"`
			} `json:"data"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &actual); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got := []int{}
		for _, row := range actual.Data {
			got = append(got, row.ID)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s rows=%v want=%v body=%s", tc.path, got, tc.want, body)
		}
	}
	if c.native != nil && c.visibility != "private-alternative" {
		result, err := c.native.CallTool(c.ctx, &schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "RecordsById", Arguments: map[string]any{}})
		var rpcErr *jsonrpc.Error
		if !errors.As(err, &rpcErr) || rpcErr.Code != jsonrpc.InvalidParams || rpcErr.Message != `missing required MCP argument "id"` || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("alternate required argument: result=%+v error=%v", result, err)
		}
	}
}

func (c withURIAcceptance) schemas(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	listed, err := c.native.ListTools(c.ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	names := []string{}
	for _, tool := range listed.Tools {
		names = append(names, tool.Name)
		// Empty properties are omitted by the native wire schema serializer.
		want := schema.ToolInputSchema{Type: "object"}
		if tool.Name == "RecordsById" {
			want.Required = []string{"id"}
			want.Properties = map[string]map[string]any{"id": {"type": "integer"}}
		}
		actual := tool.InputSchema
		// Native decoding retains absent extension keys as an empty map.
		if extensions, ok := actual.AdditionalProperties.(map[string]interface{}); ok && len(extensions) == 0 {
			actual.AdditionalProperties = nil
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s business schema=%+v want=%+v", tool.Name, tool.InputSchema, want)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	want := []string{"Records", "RecordsById"}
	if c.visibility == "hidden-base" {
		want = []string{"RecordsById"}
	}
	if c.visibility == "private-alternative" {
		want = []string{"Records"}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(names, want) {
		t.Fatalf("tools/list names=%v want=%v", names, want)
	}
}

func TestWithURIReload(t *testing.T) {
	stage1, err := filepath.Abs("..")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stage2 := os.Getenv("DATLY_WITHURI_STAGE")
	if stage2 == "" {
		t.Fatal("second generated stage required")
	}
	for _, protocol := range []struct{ name, version string }{{"http", ""}, {"mcp-session", schema.LegacyProtocolVersion}, {"mcp-stateless", schema.LatestProtocolVersion}} {
		t.Run(protocol.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			db := sqlite.New(t)
			if err := db.ExecStatements(ctx, "CREATE TABLE records(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)", "INSERT INTO records VALUES(1),(2),(3),(4)"); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			types := typecatalog.NewCatalog()
			for _, typ := range []reflect.Type{reflect.TypeOf(RecordsInput{}), reflect.TypeOf(RecordsOutput{})} {
				if err := types.Register(typecatalog.TypeOriginPackage, x.NewType(typ)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			manager, err := application.New(types)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fixture := &withURIFixture{db: db, stage: stage1}
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 1, Compile: fixture.compile}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			current := withURIAcceptance{manager: manager, ctx: ctx, visibility: os.Getenv("DATLY_WITHURI_VISIBILITY")}
			if protocol.version != "" {
				current.native = (mcpclient.Config{Source: manager, ProtocolVersion: protocol.version}).New(t)
			}
			current.check(t, 3)
			pinned, service, err := manager.Pin(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			old := withURIAcceptance{manager: manager, ctx: pinned, visibility: current.visibility}
			if protocol.version != "" {
				old.native = (mcpclient.Config{Service: service, ProtocolVersion: protocol.version}).New(t)
			}
			fixture.stage = stage2
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 2, Compile: fixture.compile}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if manager.Revision() != 2 {
				t.Fatal("revision 2 not published")
			}
			current.check(t, 4)
			old.check(t, 3)
			// WithMCP/WithPathMCP affect tools only: the HTTP branch above
			// deliberately executes both routes for both visibility variants.
			files, err := fs.Glob(DatlyResources, "sql/*.sql")
			if err != nil || len(files) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("generated SQL resources=%v error=%v", files, err)
			}
			bad := t.TempDir()
			if err = os.CopyFS(bad, os.DirFS(stage2)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err = os.Remove(filepath.Join(bad, "records", files[0])); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fixture.stage = bad
			if err = manager.Reload(ctx, application.Request{Revision: 3, Compile: fixture.compile}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), files[0]) {
				t.Fatalf("missing generated SQL stage error=%v", err)
			}
			if manager.Revision() != 2 {
				t.Fatal("failed stage replaced current revision")
			}
			current.check(t, 4)
			old.check(t, 3)
		})
	}
}
